summary: amazon.aws iam_role_info will require paths to begin and end with / in a release after 2026-05-01.
questions: Why does iam_role_info warn about my path_prefix?

answer_card.title: iam_role_info paths need leading/trailing slash
answer_card.answer_md: In a release after **2026-05-01**, `amazon.aws.iam_role_info` paths must **start and end with `/`**, e.g. `path_prefix: /service-roles/`.
